title: Why he played Dixieland
summary: Dixieland was comfortable, whiskey-drinking music with good money rather than smoking or shooting music, as bebop musicians then struggled.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well, I wanted to ask you too, was how given the fact that you learned so many different kinds of music, how is it that you ended up playing Dixieland?
Well, Dixieland -- it was comfortable. And it was -- say, it was whiskey drinking music instead of smoking music or shooting music, so, it just was there.
So you mean that you chose to play it because the social situation surrounding it was a little bit healthier?
-- and the bread was beautiful, the money was beautiful.
